## Rule

Iterative spatial seed-finding with ring-pattern matching. Finds 5 dominant cells in [1,10,30,30] grid, identifies each one's position using ArgMax+reversed-ArgMax, and applies binary ring masks to create output.

## Algorithm sketch

```
x16 = ReduceMax(input, axis=1)    # [1,1,30,30] max per cell
x18 = Cast(ArgMax(input, axis=1)) # [1,1,30,30] color index per cell
x29 = x18[row_argmax, col_argmax] # dominant cell color

# 5 iterations: find next dominant cell, mask it
for i in range(5):
    v_i = isolate_next_active_cell(x16, x18, x29)   # [1,1,30,30]
    pos_row_i, pos_col_i = find_cell_position(v_i)   # using ArgMax + reversed ArgMax (v1)
    update state...

# Apply ring masks to output
level = compute_ring_level(v217)
mask_0 = Gather(v11, level)  # [1,1,9,9] ring mask for cell 0
mask_1 = Gather(v12, level)  # [1,1,9,9] ring mask for cell 1
...
output = Pad(Cast(Equal(Sum(weighted_cells), color_indices)), [0,0,0,0,0,0,21,21])
```

## COMPRESSED HISTORY

Detailed v1-v7 derivation, superseded floor proofs, and older dead ends are archived in
`The_400_Tasks/Task_by_Task/_archive/task377_history.md` and summarized in the attempts table above.
Key retained facts: v5 decoded the true onion-to-bullseye rule and shipped at 9,887; v6 folded the
one-hot tail into graph output at 9,166; v7 used opset14 dtype narrowing at 8,192 and was later
consumed/probe_ok by Claude. The v8-v10 ladder below supersedes the old `diff`/`col_oh` forced proof.

**4,464 current floor (2026-06-21).** The v7 "diff is forced" and `col_oh` claims were both
formulation-relative. v8 counts adjacent-row color transitions per column with an ordered
`Einsum('bchw,hg,bdgw,cd->bw')`, deleting `diff` F32[1,1,29,30]=3,480B. v9 replaces the dynamic
`Gather(input,cstar)` column slice with `OneHot(cstar1)` + two input Einsums that produce only
`colcolor_f`[1,30] and `active_f`[1,30]. v10 then uses opset14 BOOL Pad to make the small
`Equal(v232u,ramp)` one-hot the charged tensor (810B) and `Pad` it as graph output, instead of
paying `vp` U8[1,1,30,30]=900B. Full AB vs already probe-ok v7 is byte-equal 200266/200266, so
correctness inherits the v7/v6/v5 proof.

**4,248 current floor (2026-06-22, v13).** Two byte-equal folds on v10: `rsi` I32->U8 (-90) and
the ring clip-fold (Clip∘Min commute, deletes the [9,9] F16 `v_ring_c`, -162). Remaining largest
charged tensors: `small_oh` BOOL[1,10,9,9]=810 (output one-hot, forced), `v8_adj_next` F32[30,30]=900
params + `v8_neq_cd` F32[10,10]=100 params (the in-kernel transition selector), `v_ring_i` I32[9,9]=324
(Gather index, INT32-forced), `v_ring_f` F16[9,9]=162, and the F32[1,30]=120 Einsum vectors
(tc/csel/colcolor_f/active_f).

**Both folder-20 prompt levers were priced and REJECTED (do not re-walk):**
- **Lever 1 (delete the [30,30] adjacency via Slice-shift) LOSES.** The adjacency is the in-kernel
  shift operator for the per-column transition selector. Any Slice-based shift first materializes a
  per-cell color-index / activity plane for ALL columns: ArgMax forces I64[1,1,30,30]=7,200; a ramp-Conv
  forces F32[1,1,30,30]=3,600 (the task096 forced-F32-marginal transit). Both DWARF the 900-param
  in-kernel Einsum. The shift matrix is rank-29 (no low-rank/structured cheaper operand). Killing only
  `neq[10,10]` via channel-contraction (two einsums sharing adj + a Sub) nets -100 params but +240 mem
  (two extra [1,30] F32) = WORSE (measured v14b = 4,388; older cand_A = 4,604). A cheaper `neq`-free equal-count + ArgMin
  selector priced at 4,148/profile 4,148 but failed visible 22/266 because inactive all-zero cells break
  the `29 - equal_count` identity. A cheaper column selector (max-active-height)
  recovers the wrong layer sequence (0/266). The 900-param adjacency IS the selector floor.
- **Lever 2 (free-output Chebyshev distance×color Einsum) LOSES — the #109 carrier tax.** The bullseye
  IS rank-2-separable (Abel/telescoping nested filled squares: `out[k,r,c]=Einsum('dr,dc,dk,b->bkrc',
  RB,RB,G,ones)`, `RB[d,r]=[d<=r<=2L-d]`, `G[d,k]=Loh[d,k]-Loh[d-1,k]`; verified 266/266 vs GT). But
  `Einsum` on ORT CPU is F32/I32-locked (NO BOOL/U8/F16 — ort_reality.md), so the `RB[7,30]` band operand
  (840) + `G[7,10]` (280) + the BOOL band-construction planes (~630) + the Loh-diff chain (~1,160) all
  charge as F32/I32, exceeding the BOOL `small_oh`=810 + `v_ring_i`=324 they delete. Measured v11/v11b =
  5,387/5,391 (+900 vs v10). The free-output frame render is ~break-even-to-worse here; the canvas-Equal-
  tail one-hot stays the floor for this renderer.

## Don't-do log

- **fp16 conversion (2026-05-19)**: Fails with `Type Error: Type (tensor(float16)) of output arg (v18) of node (Cast_3) does not match expected type (tensor(float))`. The Cast(ArgMax→float32) at node 2 is used by downstream ops expecting float32, cannot be converted.
- **v1 (reversed range) elimination via Sub(29, ArgMax) (2026-05-19)**: Mathematically equivalent for UNIQUE maxima. BUT the model deliberately uses ArgMax(original) + ArgMax(reversed) to find FIRST and LAST max positions simultaneously (for handling ties). Replacing ArgMax(Gather(x, v1)) with Sub(29, ArgMax(x)) gives wrong result when multiple cells tie for max. Not safe.
- **v11-v15 arithmetic generation (initial estimate, 2026-05-19)**: Initially estimated too costly (+40-50 nodes adding ~13k memory). WRONG — actual implementation (ringdyn) uses only 23 new nodes with [9,9] intermediates (not [1,1,9,9]×5=5×324 bytes). See ringdyn staged above.
- **from-scratch rebuild analysis (2026-05-19)**: Full audit shows no improvement path. 5-iteration structure unavoidable; [1,1,30,30] intermediates unavoidable (input is 30×30, rings anywhere). Rect-mask per iteration (21 nodes) already minimal. From-scratch would match or exceed current 80239 cost.
- **crop_to_size_advisory (2026-05-19)**: Not applicable — model already runs at 30×30 with no crop opportunity confirmed by spread scan.
- **the 2026-05-31 prompt's "72,000 B INT64 + INT32-narrow + crop to 10-20k" plan (2026-06-01)**: STALE recon — do not pursue. The 72,000 B [1,10,30,30] INT64 was already collapsed (color index is `v17` [1,1,30,30] INT64 = 7,200 B) and LIVE was fp16-converted to 63,682 before the prompt was written. (a) No INT32-narrow: the only big INT64 is `ArgMax`'s `v17`, which ONNX forces to INT64 — and §8c INT32-narrowing only helps *Gather indices*, which `v17` is not. (b) No crop: input is 30×30. Always re-run `recon_task377.py` against the *current* `submission.zip` model, never trust a day-old prompt's byte counts.
- **INT64→INT32 on `v17` (2026-06-01)**: impossible — `v17 = ArgMax(...)` and ONNX `ArgMax` output dtype is INT64 by spec; there is no INT32 ArgMax. The only way to remove the 7,200 B is to not use ArgMax for the color index → a `Conv`/`MatMul` color-ramp (v2), which introduces a novel op (grader-risk). A weighted `ReduceSum(input*ramp)` does NOT help — `input*ramp` re-materialises the [1,10,30,30] canvas (18,000 B), defeating the point.
- **"output one-hot [1,10,9,9]=1,620 irreducible" (2026-06-01)**: WRONG — superseded by v6 (2026-06-11). Folding the `Equal→Cast→Pad` one-hot into the **graph output tensor** (`Pad` a [1,1,30,30] U8 value canvas `vp`=900, then `Equal(vp, ramp[1,10,1,1])` IS the output) drops 1,620→900 because `calculate_memory` skips tensors named `output`. Always check whether the final one-hot/Equal can be the output node rather than a charged intermediate.
- **front-end F16/INT narrowing of `diff`(3,480)/`col_oh`(1,200) (2026-06-11)**: BLOCKED by F32 `input`. Both are Conv/Gather outputs that inherit input dtype; any `Cast(input→F16)` re-materializes the 18,000 B canvas (confirmed: F16-front-end Conv = 19,808, far worse). Std `Conv` is float-only; `ConvInteger`→int32 = same bytes. These two are the structural floor.
- **merging the two F32 reduce-transients (2026-06-01)**: tried on paper — `Conv(input, [2,10,1,1])` to emit active(ch0)+coloridx(ch1) in one [1,2,30,30] (7,200 F32) is the SAME bytes as the two separate [1,1,30,30] F32 (3,600+3,600) and adds a Split. Max is non-linear so it can't share the Conv anyway (active=Σ works only because one-hot ⇒ max==sum). No gain.
- **uint8 narrowing of the activity/reduction track f16→uint8 (2026-06-01)**: BLOCKED at opset 11 — verified by `probe_uint8_ops.py`. In **opset 11, `ReduceMax` / `ReduceSum` / `Mul` / `Sum` reject `tensor(uint8)`**. Bool is even more restricted (Pad-11 rejects bool). **⚠️ SUPERSEDED by v7 (2026-06-19)**: At **opset14**, BOOL Pad IS supported and U8 ReduceMax IS supported. The v7 front-end pipeline (active, cch, ti, col_trans) all go BOOL, and the color extraction (mk, scalars, v_rcol, v_total) go U8. The key path: `Cast(active32,BOOL)` instead of F16, `Equal(ca_u8,cb_u8)+Not` instead of Sub/Abs/Min, `And(BOOL,BOOL)`, `Pad(BOOL)`, then Cast(BOOL→F16) only for CumSum (which still requires F16/F32). This saves ~800B vs the v6 F16 pipeline. The reduction ops (ReduceL1, ArgMax, ReduceMax over [1,10,30]) still use F32 (from F32 input), and CumSum stays F16. But post-CumSum color extraction converts to U8 cleanly.
